file_stem: RWB E1 031 Queue and owner on the case list with filters
title: Queue and owner on the case list with filters
goal: Managers see queue and owner, filter by queue, team and status, and export a masked, logged file
why: Managers stop rebuilding lists in Excel. Only in-scope cases are shown, and every export is logged before the file is built.
triggers: Team manager on SCR-02 Case list
ace_note: No direct ACE read. Personal columns in the export are masked through FieldMasker (E1-037).

reads.note: in-scope cases with owner and status

stores: xlsx download 'Case list YYYYMMDD 1.xlsx'; access log

functions.name: CaseExportService
functions.does: row limit, log first, masked xlsx

rules: BR1: only in-scope cases are returned (Own, Team, Region, All)
BR3: every export is logged before the file is made (CTL-11)
BR4: export columns are masked by role
example: U-71 (team DIL-BKK, scope Team) filters queue DIL-BKK-CO, status ASSIGNED
